title: 第214章 绝地反击
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

靳轩一句话，在场人都懵了，包括楚穆。

“小王爷，你说京城布有强军，果有此事？为何我们不知道，黑甲军身负京城守卫之责，还有什么人能够替代我们？”

韩飞龙是个急性子，想什么就说什么。

“哈哈……韩叔，京城防军未必比得过黑甲军，但守卫京师绰绰有余！”

靳轩顿了下，接着道：“想必各位都知道，先前我遭人陷害入狱，并背负投敌卖国之罪名，碰巧，所投之国正是北燕，诸位不觉得奇怪吗，为何事事都能跟北燕扯在一起？至于那个铁先生，大帅和绍英哥还有我对其还算熟知，就是他勾结京城某位高官陷害于我，至于是谁，就算我不说，诸位也该知道，所以那日得知北燕与南凉结盟侵犯雁门关我就觉得事情不对劲，出于谨慎，便上奏天子将镇西大将军邓九熊的十万镇西军秘密掉入京城，扮作常人潜伏在京城之中，为的就是防止北燕直捣黄龙，看来当初的猜想是对的！”

原来如此，虽然还不确定靳轩所言究竟真假，但却让人松了口气。

“小王爷，此话当真？”

“呵呵……韩叔，我骗过您吗，再说事关天子性命，我怎敢以此玩笑，所以大家尽管放心，京城不会有事，天子更不会有事，我们目前的当务之急就是给燕凉联军来个当头痛击，不给他们再战的机会同样也不给我们留下后退的余地，可谓背水一战，诸位将军可否敢于冒死一战！”

“战！战！战！”

一时间营帐气氛被点燃，那些主张死守的人也开始犹豫起来。

靳轩看看楚穆，毕竟他才是一军统帅，就算你有一百八十个弯弯，楚穆不点头那也白费。

“靳轩，有什么你就说吧，我老了，脑子没有你活络，如果你说的却是有道理，那么本帅便无条件支持！”

有了这句话，靳轩终于说出几日来的构思与想法。

“最近几日，我军为了是攻还是守闹得不可开交，当然，无论是主攻还是主守都有其道理，这里我想对那些主张守的将军们说说，主攻我们有两个优势一个劣势，主守毫无优势可言。”

“先说主守，目前我军只剩下五万人马，而敌军至少还有十万，硬守未必守不住，但各位想想，就算我们守下来还剩什么，很有可能全军覆没，你我在场所有人均不能幸免，那时苦的就是雁门关各郡镇的百姓，而我们黑甲军的名号将不复存在，这便是死守的结果。”

靳轩说的很有道理，但有时候一个人的想法很难改变，其中一个上了年纪的老将站起身，抱拳问道：“小王爷，您说死守百害无一利，那么敢问主动进攻的两利一害又是什么呢？”

“哈哈……老将军问的好，所谓两利一害中的害就是我刚才说的敌我双方兵力不对等，而两利则是指偷袭与速度。”

“请小王爷具体说明。”

“首先说偷袭，北燕军直接打到安阳，这是我们没想到的，当然联军也会认为我们想不到，在他们眼里，此时我们正急忙回撤，回京擒王，所以天明之后，雁门关就是一座空城，他们很容易便占领这里，基于以上因素，联军今夜防守必然松懈，我军突袭必然大获全胜。”

“再说这个快字，此战绝不能拖沓，不要想着擒获敌军主将，以歼敌为主，大量歼灭敌军有生力量，所谓巧妇难为无米之炊，就算孟良和殷夺魁再狡猾，手里没兵也翻不出什么浪花来，反之，战斗一旦持久，之前的优势便荡然无存，懂了吗？”

靳轩一下阐述，那位提问的老将军连连点头。

Page (1/3)

Jin Xuan's words made everyone present stunned, including Chu Mu.

"My young prince, you said that there is a strong army in the capital. Is this true? Why don't we know that the black-armored army is responsible for guarding the capital? Who else can replace us?"

Han Feilong is an impatient person and says whatever he thinks.

"Haha...Uncle Han, the capital defense army may not be as good as the black armored army, but it is more than enough to defend the capital!"

Jin Xuan paused for a moment and then continued: "Everyone must know that I was framed and imprisoned before, and was accused of surrendering to the enemy and betraying my country. By chance, the country I surrendered to was Beiyan. Don't you find it strange that everything is related to Beiyan? As for Mr. Tie, the Marshal, Brother Shao Ying, and I are quite familiar with him. He colluded with a high-ranking official in the capital to frame me.As for who it is, even if I don’t say it, you all should know it, so that day when I learned that Beiyan had formed an alliance with Nanliang to invade Yanmen Pass, I felt that something was wrong. Out of caution, I reported to the emperor that General Deng Jiuxiong’s 100,000 Zhenxi Army secretly fell into the capital and lurked in the capital disguised as ordinary people, in order to prevent Beiyan from attacking Huanglong. It seems that my original guess was right!"

It turns out that this is the case. Although it is still uncertain whether what Jin Xuan said is true or false, it makes people feel relieved.

"Young prince, are you serious about this?"

"Haha...Uncle Han, have I lied to you? Besides, it is about the emperor's life. How dare I joke about it, so everyone can rest assured that nothing will happen to the capital, and the emperor will be fine. Our top priority right now is to give the Yanliang coalition a head-on blow. Not giving them a chance to fight again will not leave us any room to retreat. It can be said to be a last-ditch battle. Generals, can you dare to risk your life to fight!"

"Fight! Fight! Fight!"

For a time, the atmosphere in the camp was ignited, and those who advocated holding on began to hesitate.

Jin Xuan looked at Chu Mu. After all, he is the commander-in-chief of the army. Even if you have one hundred and eighty bends, it will be in vain if Chu Mu doesn't nod.

"Jin Xuan, just say what you have to say. I am old and my brain is not as sharp as yours. If what you say makes sense, then I will support it unconditionally!"

With these words, Jin Xuan finally expressed his ideas and thoughts for the past few days.

"In recent days, our army has been arguing over whether to attack or defend. Of course, whether it is to attack or to defend, there are reasons. Here I want to say something to those generals who advocate defense. We have two advantages and one disadvantage in the main attack. There is no advantage at all in the main defense."

"Let's talk about the main defense first. At present, our army only has 50,000 troops left, while the enemy has at least 100,000. We may not be able to hold on if we hold on. But think about it, even if we hold on to what is left, it is very likely that the entire army will be annihilated. You and I will not be spared. The people in the counties and towns of Yanmen Pass will suffer at that time, and the name of our Black Armored Army will no longer exist. This is the result of holding on."

What Jin Xuan said makes sense, but sometimes it is difficult to change a person's mind. One of the elderly veterans stood up, clasped his fists and asked: "Little Prince, you said that defending will do no good, so what are the two benefits and one harm of taking the initiative to attack?"

"Haha... The old general asked a good question. The so-called "two advantages and one disadvantage" is the unequal strength of the enemy and our troops that I just mentioned, while the two advantages refer to sneak attacks and speed."

"Please give me details, young prince."

"First of all, let's talk about the sneak attack. The Beiyan Army directly hit Anyang. This was something we didn't expect. Of course, the coalition forces would also think that we didn't expect it. In their eyes, we were hurriedly retreating and returning to Beijing to capture the king. So after dawn, Yanmen Pass will be an empty city. They can easily occupy it. Based on the above factors, the coalition defense will definitely be relaxed tonight, and our army's surprise attack will definitely win a complete victory."

"Let's talk about this quick word again. This battle must not be delayed. Don't think about capturing the enemy's general. Focus on annihilating the enemy and annihilating the enemy's effective strength in large numbers. The so-called clever woman can't make a meal without rice. No matter how cunning Meng Liang and Yin Duokui are, they can't make any splash if they don't have soldiers. On the contrary, once the battle lasts, the previous advantage will be gone. Do you understand?"

Jin Xuan elaborated, and the old general who asked the question nodded repeatedly.
